snippet.title: Official Trailer – Orms | Gamescom 2025 Reveal
snippet.description:
“Some journeys begin in silence... and end in light.”

Step into the world of Orms, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure where shadows speak louder than words. Follow Sam, a young boy lost in a surreal world shaped by childhood fears, and Kira, a mysterious companion who brings warmth, courage, and light.

Orms isn’t just a game. It’s an emotional journey.
Coming soon to PC, with future plans of consoles, and mobile.

#OrmsGame #Gamescom2025 #IndieDev #NarrativeGames #darkfantasy
